book.title: JON Jiysis Minim Tep Jon Tikak

content: Jiysis Numam Nuk Gok Yip
Kisen pen Jiwda biyomb gok, Jiysis nup ñaŋgniŋg gey niŋiy, Jiwdiya propens ma giraŋgyiŋgip; Galiyliy propens nep giraŋgyiŋgip.
Pen Jiwda ñin yomb kiyk, korip bandak band giy miñmiñ giyiŋgipay ak, maŋ maŋ gakniŋ,
Jiysis numam sikop, nup kunep ma gos niŋyak rek, mindek ak apiy aŋgyak, “Nand Biyomb mindpan rek, Jiwdiya amiy, biynimb minim nip niŋniŋg winiŋgiy gok, tap mageprek gipan rek gunap gey niŋniŋgiy.
Biynimb yomb mindniŋg gipay gok, tap kiyk gok weygiy ma gipay; miseŋ yimb gipay. Kun ak nand bi key yimb gipan ak, tap mageprek gunap gey, biynimb maŋgiysek niŋniŋgiy aŋgyak.”
Kun aŋgey, Jiysis kuyip aŋgak, “Ñin monmon gok, ñin nimb ak mey, amniŋg amniŋgambim. Pen Gor yip aŋgayip ñin ak ma wip.
Biynimb Gor nup ma chiŋgpay gok, tap siy tap timey gipim aŋgen niŋiy, yip miluk niŋbay; pen nimbip niŋiy miluk niŋniŋgiy rek ma mindip.
Kun ak ñin yomb ak maŋ asaw rek, Jerusalem amnimimb; pen ñin yand ak ma wip rek, yand yip ma amniŋgambun aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgiy, nuk Galiyliy mindek.
Jiysis Ñin Yomb Owakniŋ Jerusalem Amnak
Pen kun aŋgek numam sikop nind amniyak. Kisen nuk amniŋg; miseŋ ma amnak, wey wey giyiŋg amnak.
Pen Jiwda biyomb gok, Jiysis akay aŋgiy, biynimb kuŋay ap mindeyak gok kuyip aŋgniŋyak.
Pen biynimb yikop gok, Jiwda biyomb kun gok kuyip pirikyak rek, minim kapkap aŋgyiŋg aŋgyak, “Jiysis bi tep yimb aŋgyak.” Gunap pen aŋgyak, “Mer. Nuk biynimb gok kuyip tom gip sek aŋgyak.”
Ñin yomb kiyk kun ak, yep ñin kaw bap nep mindakniŋ, Jiysis apchakiy, Gor aŋgniŋep korip ak amiy, kuyip minim aŋgñak.
Aŋgñek niŋiy, Jiwda biyomb gok wal aŋgiy aŋgyak, “Bi biy sikul ma aŋgak ak pen, yergiy minim okok maŋgiysek niŋimb aŋgyak.”
Kun aŋgyak ak pen, Jiysis aŋgak, “Minim aŋgñimbiyn gok, yand key niŋiy ma apiyn; Bi yip aŋgyokek winik anep gos ñamb apiyn.
Biynimb Gor aŋgip rek gun aŋgiy gi dand amniŋgambay gok, Gor minim nup akaŋ, minim yand key apiyn ak, kuyip gos ñek niŋniŋgambay.

Nimb niŋbim: biynimb minim kiyk key aŋgniŋgambay gok, yimb chin aranimuŋ aŋgiy, minim okok nimb okok nimb aŋgniŋgambay. Pen Gor bi yokek minim nup aŋgniŋg wip ak; bi minim yipund giy nep aŋgniŋgamb ak mey; yesek aŋgnimuŋ rek ma mindip.
Mosis, Gor aŋgak aŋgak rek low gunap aŋgñak ak pen; nimb bap low ar kun gok kindik ma gipim. Minim bap mindek mer; yip yikop yimb ñaŋgniŋg gispim aŋgak.”
Jiysis kun aŋgek, biynimb ap mindeyak gok aŋgyak, “Nip an ñaŋgniŋg gisap. Nip kichekiy ambaŋ ayamb aspan?”
Aŋgey, Jiysis aŋgak, “Yand tap mageprek nokom bap genik, nimb maŋgiysek lotiw ñin ak yenen kun gip aŋgiy, jiwdipik.

Nimb Mosis aŋgak rek, ñi gok tikiy, ñin onep ar ak mindiy, minek jiy ak kumbak tikpim. Gipim kun ak Mosis nuk mer, nasind yes sikop nind kiñiŋ gi gey mey kun gipim. Pen kumbak tikpim kun ak, ñin gunap Jiwda lotiw ñin ak apek, ma kirpim; monmon kumbak tikpim. Gipim kun ak rek, lotiw ñin ak, bi bap nup gen pisnep suŋ ayak ak; yip yenen miluk niŋbim.
Kun ak kisen minim ar ar nep niŋiy ma aŋgnimimb; niŋrep giy, yipund giniŋgamb ar ak niŋiy aŋgnimimb aŋgak.”
Jiysis Mey, Kiyŋ Yomb Key Yimb Ak Akaŋ Aŋgyak
Jerusalem biynimb gunap aŋgyak, “Biyomb gok, bi ñaŋgun aŋgiy niŋbay ak, mey biy rek ayip?
Pen niŋim! Bi kun ak nuk biynimb namb yomb biy minim aŋgakniŋ, pen minim bap ma aspay. Kun ak kiyk key, nuk bi kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak aŋgiy niŋbay rek ayip!
Pen bi kiyŋ yomb key yimb opkop ak, akay nimb wip aŋgiy ma niŋbinup; bi biy akay nimb wip ak chin maŋgiysek niŋbun aŋgyak.”

Pen Jiysis Gor aŋgniŋep korip miŋgan biyaŋ, minim aŋg nep mindyiŋg, meŋg miŋgan dand araniy aŋgak, “Nimbik yip niŋrep yimb giy, akay nimb winik ak niŋbim. Pen yand key ma winik; Bi biynimb aŋgdep ak nep yip aŋgyokek winik. Yand nuk yip mindiy, yip aŋgyokek winik rek nup niŋbiyn; pen nimbik nup ma niŋbim aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgek, nup chichiy diy dand kor amnun aŋgiy niŋyak ak pen; Nop Gor nup pikayniŋgambay aŋgiy aŋgayak ñin ak ma owak rek, biynimb bap nup ma chichiy diyak.

Pen biynimb kuŋaynep kun gok, gunap Jiysis bi kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak aŋgiy niŋyak. Niŋiy aŋgyak, “Bi kiyŋ yomb key yimb kisen winiŋgamb apay ak, tap mageprek kuŋaynep giy, bi biy nup wiyniym ginimuŋ rek ma ayip aŋgyak.”
Jiysis Nup Am Dand Wim Aŋgiy, Poliys Gok Kuyip Aŋgyokyak

Pen biynimb gok, bi kiyŋ yomb key yimb anup minim kun ak kapkap aŋgeyak niŋiy, bi Peresiy gok sek, bi Gor nup tap simboŋgep yomb gok sek Jiysis nup am dand winimimb aŋgiy, Jiwda poliys gunap aŋgyokyak.
Jiysis pen aŋgak, “Yand yep won bap mindiy, Bi yip yokamb opiyn ak ker tip amniŋgayn.
Yip akay amimb aŋgiy piyowniŋgambim ak pen, ma niŋniŋgambim. Yand amniŋgayn ar ak, nimb kisen ginimimb rek ma ayip aŋgak.”

Kun aŋgek, Jiwda biyomb gok kiyk keynep aŋgniŋ aŋgniŋ giy aŋgyak, “Nuk akay amek, nup ma niŋniŋgambun? Nuk am Jiwda biynimb jiw am Griyk mindpay okok amiy, biynimb kun okok kuyip minim aŋgñiyiŋg mindeniŋgamb nup ma niŋniŋgambun?
Pen yenen aŋgip, ‘Yip piyow niŋiy ma niŋniŋgambim; amniŋgayn ar ak kisen ginimimb rek ma ayip aŋgip’ aŋgyak.”
Gor Kawnan Ak Ñiŋg Kilam Rek Jiwiy Winiŋgamb
Jiwda ñin yomb kiyk kun ak, ñin kisen yimb ak apek, Jiysis tikjakiy, meŋg miŋgan dand araniy aŋgak, “Biynimb an kuŋam kinjik gek, yip ker apiy ñiŋg ñiŋniŋgiy.
Biynimb yip gosimb niŋniŋgambay gok, Baybol buk ak aŋgip rek, ñiŋg ñimbiy perper mindeniŋgambay ak, namb kuyip biyaŋ kilam jiwiy winiŋgamb aŋgak.”

Ñin kun ak, Jiysis kumiy tikjakiy Nop ker ma amek mey, Gor Kawnan nuk ak biynimb gok kuyip ma yokak. Ñiŋg kilam jiwiy winiŋgamb minim aŋgak kun ak; nup gosimb niŋey, Gor Kawnan ap kiy yip mindiy, giniŋgamb rek aŋgak.
Kiyk Key Tuŋg Asik Keykey Ayak
Jiysis kun aŋgek, biynimb kuŋaynep kun gok, gunap minim aŋgak kun ak niŋiy aŋgyak, “Bi biy, bi Gor minim aŋgep winiŋgamb aŋgiy kond mindyiŋgipun ak aŋgyak.”
Gunap aŋgyak, “Nuk bi kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak aŋgyak!” Kun aŋgeyak, gunap pen aŋgyak, “Kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak Galiyliy nimb ma winiŋgamb!
Baybol buk ak aŋgip rek, Jiwda bi kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak, Depiyt tikek tik dand amiy apiy giy, tikniŋgambay Depiyt miñmon nuk Betliyhem aŋgyak.”
Jiysis nup nen aŋgiy, biynimb kuŋay mindeyak kun gok, asik pis ak key, pis ak key ay,
gunap nup diy dand kor amnun aŋgyak ak pen, nup ma diyak.
Jiwda Biyomb Gok Nup Ma Gos Niŋyak
Pen Jiwda poliys gok andkind amey, bi Peresiy gok sek, bi Gor nup simboŋgep yomb gok sek aŋgyak, “Bi kun anup yenen ma dand opim?”
Aŋgey, bi poliys kun gok aŋgyak, “Biynimb bap, bi kun ak minim tep yimb aŋgip rek ma apay aŋgyak.”
Kun aŋgey, bi Peresiy gok aŋgyak, “Nimb biynimb gunap bi tom gip kun ak niŋind aŋgip aŋgiy niŋbay rek niŋbim?
Bi chin Peresiy bap akaŋ, Jiwda biyomb gunap nup gos niŋiy ma dipay.
Biynimb guniy kiyk Mosis low ak ma niŋbay rek, yiwur yomb diniŋgambay aŋgyak.”
Pen bi kiyk Niykodiymas, bi nind kisyimken amiy Jiysis nup minim gunap aŋgniŋak ak, kuyip aŋgak,
“Jiwda low chin ar ak, bi bap nup timey gipan aŋgiy, yikop kalambis ma aypun; kor giy junj bap niŋiy nep mey, kun gipun aŋgak.”
Aŋgek aŋgyak, “Nak kunep Galiyliy nimb rek? Baybol buk ak riytiym gi dand amiy niŋniŋgamban: bi Gor minim aŋgep bap, Galiyliy nimb ma winiŋgamb aŋgyak.”
[Kun aŋgiy, kiyk maŋgiysek korip kiyk keykey amniyak.
